picks.matchup: UConn vs Duke (T-Mobile Arena, Las Vegas)
picks.reasoning: ESPN BPI makes Duke a 55.2% favorite, while the market has UConn -2.5 and ML -137 to -155. Against us: the line moved from Duke +1.5 to +2.5, and 91% of ML money is on UConn (Action Network). FanDuel -108 is the best price; DK and BetMGM are -115.
